instruction: Buy me the top-rated watch that's available now on amazon for each of my brothers, and have it delivered to their homes with gift wrapping. I want to give them identical gifts.
notes: Fix: the type addr-name collided with the predicate addr-name; the type is now recipient-name and the address-component predicates are address-recipient/address-street/address-city/address-state/address-country/address-zip (all names are unique across types, predicates, constants and objects). Assumes two brothers (brother-1, brother-2); for a different count add person/address objects and extend the complete-task parameters. Brothers and their home addresses come from phone.search_contacts(relationship='brother'); since STRIPS cannot assert per-contact knowledge from one call, the search sets the nullary (siblings-located) flag that gates address creation. Phone username is the supervisor's phone number, amazon username the email. The top-rated watch is found via amazon.search_products(product_type='watch', sort_by='-rating') (if descending sort is unsupported, scan all pages for max rating) and its stock confirmed via amazon.show_product. Each brother gets a separate order: add his home address (amazon.add_address, allowed by the evaluation), add the watch to the cart with quantity 1 and clear_cart_first=true so the order contains only that item, add gift wrapping (quantity 1), and place the order with the card on file and that address; place_order empties the cart state so the cycle repeats. Goal demands a gift-wrapped order of the same product to each brother's home address; supervisor.complete_task (no answer) is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on all actions and uses :equality to require two distinct brothers.

plan: (amazon-add-address name-brother-1 street-brother-1 city-brother-1 state-brother-1 country-brother-1 zip-brother-1 amazon-token brother-1 addr-brother-1)
(amazon-add-address name-brother-2 street-brother-2 city-brother-2 state-brother-2 country-brother-2 zip-brother-2 amazon-token brother-2 addr-brother-2)
